# PersonAddressInput

An address as written to a person record. Reads come back as PersonAddress, which surfaces only the best known Home and Mailing addresses and adds several standardization fields.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addressLine1` | string or null | First line of the street address. |
| `addressLine2` | string or null | Second line of the street address. |
| `addressLine3` | string or null | Third line of the street address. |
| `city` | string or null | City or town. |
| `stateOrProvince` | string or null | Two or three character state or province code, e.g. "MN", "ON", "NSW". |
| `zipOrPostalCode` | string or null | ZIP, ZIP+4, postal code, post code, etc. |
| `countryCode` | string or null | Two character ISO country code supported by the VAN context. Defaults to the context's country. |
| `type` | string or null | `Home` and `Voting` mean the same thing and read back as `Voting`. Some types are unavailable in some contexts. An address written as `Work` or `Custom` is stored but never appears under $expand=addresses. When a person has no mailing address, their home address serves as the mailing address too. One of: `Mailing`, `Home`, `Voting`, `Work`, `Custom`, `None`. |

`*` = required.
